cards.meaning: driven by / propelled by (a specific force pushing an outcome forward)
cards.example: 在疲软就业数据的推动下，股市反而全线上涨了。
cards.examplePinyin: Zài píruǎn jiùyè shùjù de tuīdòng xià, gǔshì fǎn'ér quánxiàn shàngzhǎng le.
cards.exampleMeaning: Driven by the weak jobs data, the stock market rallied across the board instead.
cards.note: Formal/书面语 collocation standard in financial and industry-trend reporting, HSK 4. Contrasts with the plain causal 因为…所以 ('because...so'), which anyone can use for any cause-effect pair — 在…的推动下 specifically frames a named force as actively pushing an outcome forward, and implies the push is ongoing, not a one-off trigger, which is why finance writers reach for it over the plain-causal version.
cards.tiesTo: Market Overview / Deep Dive — markets rallying on the weak jobs print, and SpaceX's build pace accelerating on Nvidia's vendor financing

cards.meaning: supply-demand imbalance (a structural mismatch between supply and demand)
cards.example: 数据中心用电的供需失衡，逼着SpaceX这样的公司自己建电厂。
cards.examplePinyin: Shùjù zhōngxīn yòngdiàn de gōngxū shīhéng, bīzhe SpaceX zhèyàng de gōngsī zìjǐ jiàn diànchǎng.
cards.exampleMeaning: The supply-demand imbalance in data-center electricity is forcing a company like SpaceX to build its own power plants.
cards.note: Formal economic collocation, HSK 4, contrasts with the casual 不够用 ('not enough to use'), which just flags a plain quantity shortfall. 供需失衡 names a structural mismatch between the whole supply system and demand growth — the two curves themselves don't line up — rather than a temporary shortage, the register analysts reach for describing capacity crunches like the AI-power buildout.
cards.tiesTo: Energy segment — the data-center power/interconnection crunch driving SpaceX, Microsoft, and RWE's exit from US offshore wind

cards.meaning: decline, drop (a gradual or general decrease)
cards.example: Malaking pagbaba ang naitala sa trabaho sa Estados Unidos noong Hulyo.
cards.exampleMeaning: A large decline was recorded in US jobs in July.
cards.note: More general and neutral than bumagsak (already taught, which is abrupt and forceful, like a building or price 'collapsing') — pagbaba covers gradual or ongoing decreases, such as inflation slowing over several months, not a sudden steep drop in one print.
cards.tiesTo: Market Overview / China — the July US jobs decline and China's cooling CPI/PPI data

cards.meaning: passed, forwarded (a bill, budget, or formal proposal through official process)
cards.example: Ipinasa na ng Kagawaran ng Badyet ang 7.2 trilyong pisong badyet kay Pangulong Marcos.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Department of Budget and Management has already forwarded the 7.2-trillion-peso budget to President Marcos.
cards.note: Implies a formal process behind the transfer — a vote, committee approval, or official submission — distinct from the simpler ibinigay ('given/handed over'), which carries no procedural weight. Used for both the DBM's budget submission and the House committee's approval of the tax-exemption bill.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines — the ₱7.2 trillion 2027 budget submission and the House panel's income-tax exemption bill
